name: Olèrdola (Spain)
description: Dark blue field with the yellow castle of the arms at the centre and two yellow pales near the hoist and the fly edges.
history: The flag was approved by the municipal council on 23 December 2003 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya; it adopts the colours of the arms (approved 11 November 1992) with the castle, replacing the accompanying figures by two pales: an oblong flag of 2:3, dark blue, with the yellow castle 2/3 of the height at the centre and two yellow pales each 1/9 of the length at 1/9 from the hoist and fly.

features.role: castle of the arms, 2/3 of the height
